purpose: Train and measure one standalone pixel-to-descriptor vehicle Re-ID core. The previous residual MLP over frozen combined_v1 is not this experiment.
hypothesis: A single compact image encoder with global and two horizontal-local descriptors can run faster than the two-OSNet d1_j48 ensemble while retaining useful cross-camera retrieval quality.

architecture.backbone: torchvision MobileNetV3-Small features, ImageNet-1K V1 initialization, all feature layers trainable in stage 2
architecture.own_mechanism: one 256-dimensional global branch and two independently projected 128-dimensional horizontal stripe branches, concatenated and L2-normalized
architecture.input: float32 RGB NCHW 0..255, 208x208 bbox crop; 1/255 and ImageNet mean/std applied inside the graph
architecture.inference_dependency: one exported ONNX image encoder; no OSNet, combined_v1, teacher feature or whitening required
architecture.weights_provenance: TorchVision MobileNet_V3_Small_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1; external initialization disclosed, not claimed as our architecture or training data
architecture.license_review: TorchVision code is BSD-3-Clause; TorchVision states pretrained weights can inherit dataset terms. Raw external weights stay local pending final redistribution review.

data.train_source: D:/lct-reid/data/combined_train.npz with aligned combined_crops_208.npy; 7248 own and 13328 previously permitted CARLA/Roundabout crops
data.fit_dev_rule: exclude all 100 previously selected own dev vehicle IDs from training; external IDs all remain fit; fixed dev query/gallery rows from split.json
data.dev_preprocess: Use the same fixed combined_crops_208.npy rows for both baseline and new core on dev. The baseline consumes these as float32 RGB 0..255 NCHW through its release preprocessing and release whitening; do not refit whitening on dev.
data.dev_baseline_limitation: The existing release whitening historically saw dev100. Dev selection is therefore not independent of the baseline pipeline; report this explicitly and never call dev or reused val untouched.
data.evaluation: existing reused val, never used for checkpoint, fusion or threshold selection
data.limitation: The 1110x750 val has been reused in prior experiments. This is a paired comparison on a known split, not an untouched holdout.

training.stage1_trainable: global/local projections and classifier, pretrained backbone frozen
training.stage2_trainable: all backbone, global/local projections and classifier
training.sampler: 8 vehicle IDs x 4 frames; prefer different cameras for positive pairs; never treat same-ID same-camera as a cross-camera positive
training.classification_loss: cross-entropy on fit identities, label_smoothing=0.1, weight=1.0
training.metric_loss: batch-hard margin triplet on L2 descriptors, cross-camera positives only, margin=0.3, weight=0.5
training.augmentation: horizontal flip p=0.5 and light color jitter on fit only; no label-dependent view annotations
training.checkpoint_selection: highest dev cosine mAP with market same-camera exclusion after each stage2 epoch; ties earlier epoch
training.pilot: first 2 stage1 epochs: finite loss/gradients, loss decreases, measured epoch time, peak VRAM below 3.6 GiB; stop if any fails
training.checkpoint_contract: torch.save dict with model_state_dict, num_ids, protocol_sha256, model_config; strict reload in export

selection.fusion: For weight w in [0.25,0.5,0.75], L2-normalize each 512D branch and concatenate [sqrt(1-w)*release_baseline, sqrt(w)*new_core] into a 1024D research descriptor. Its pairwise cosine is (1-w)*baseline cosine + w*core cosine for Q-Q/Q-G/G-G. Run KR once on these fused descriptors, never average two separately reranked score matrices. Select one w by dev cosine mAP, ties smaller w; reuse w for KR.
selection.baseline_dev: Use the same two release ONNX files, release normalization and lw_ens_j48_rho0.5.npz on dev and val; no fit-only or dev-refit whitening.
selection.threshold: maximize presence F1 on dev precision-recall curve, tie higher threshold; separate for each model and cosine/KR

evaluation.multiplicity: Holm across new-core cosine/KR and fusion cosine/KR mAP deltas
evaluation.candidate_acceptance: Adopt the standalone core or fused variant only if its KR mAP delta >= +0.005 with paired CI95 lower > 0, cosine mAP delta >= 0, refusal F1 no worse than -0.02 in both modes, and every performance limit below passes. Otherwise keep d1_j48. A 1024D fused candidate additionally requires an explicit versioned index/API migration before release.
evaluation.export_tolerance: Torch vs ONNX max absolute descriptor difference <=1e-5 on real crops; same top-1 and refusal decisions on all validation rows at dev-frozen thresholds

benchmark.device: same workstation CPU for release and new ONNX
benchmark.order: paired interleaved baseline/core/fusion with model order reversed every sample
benchmark.boundary: same preprocessed 208x208 float32 tensor to final L2 descriptor; no JPEG decode, API, Qdrant or KR

release_performance_limits.inference_VRAM: NOT APPLICABLE: production inference and paired benchmark are CPU-only; training GPU peak must remain below 3.6 GiB as specified in pilot
release_performance_limits.gallery_index: 512D standalone raw 750-row float32 index <=1536000 bytes; 1024D research fusion <=3072000 bytes before Qdrant overhead

release: d1_j48 remains untouched until the candidate passes all frozen acceptance conditions
